name: TableWatch
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgl1 libglib2.0-0 && pip install --user torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip install --user -r requirements.txt

postAttachCommand.dashboard: python -m streamlit run tablewatch/dashboard/app.py --server.headless true --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
